jobs: show header and footer on slide change
hide header and footer on new slides
open a table of contents from the header
attach a resize handle for a docked pane
keep the resize handle synced to the pane
summary: Part of the slide viewer's open routine: it sets up header and footer hiding for slides built while those bars are away, the table of contents opened from the header mark, and the resize handle for a docked pane. Each piece registers its cleanup so closing the viewer releases it.

jobs: close on the close button or background tap
push a history entry so Back closes it
animate a nested viewer in from the right
jump to the starting slide after layout
return a handle for controlling the viewer
summary: Last part of the slide viewer's open routine: it adds the viewer to the page, lets Back and the Escape key close it, and returns the handle callers use to change or close it. A viewer opened from inside another slides in from the right, and the starting slide is set once the page has laid out.

jobs: check whether the host allows docking
apply the host's own docking condition
summary: Returns true only when the host exposes a docking function and that function's condition holds. A condition given as a function is called, a condition given as a media query is matched, and no condition counts as allowed; a function that throws counts as not allowed, and a media query that cannot be parsed counts as allowed.

jobs: point the header link at an address
set the link's icon or logo
hide the header link without an address
summary: Takes a link with an address, a tooltip title, and either logo markup or an icon name, and replaces the whole face of the header link button to match. A link with no address hides the button, and logo markup wins over an icon name when both are given.

jobs: build a round icon button for a header action
run the action when the button is pressed
summary: Takes an action with a title, an icon name, and a click handler, and returns a small round icon button with a tooltip and label. Pressing it calls the handler with the slide viewer and the button itself, and a missing title or icon falls back to a generic label and a three-dot icon.

jobs: show the dock toggle only when allowed
show whether the pane is docked
summary: Hides the dock toggle when the host does not allow docking. Otherwise it sets the toggle's tooltip, label, pressed state, and icon to say what a press will do and whether the pane is docked now.

jobs: toggle between docked and filling the pane
refresh the toggle, lock and resize handle
summary: On a press, asks the host to switch the viewer between docked beside its list and filling the pane, then updates the toggle, the scroll lock, and the resize handle to match the new state.

jobs: open a dropdown menu under a header button
replace any header menu already open
keep the menu inside the window
close the menu on a click elsewhere
summary: Takes a button, a list of rows, and an optional width, and shows the rows as a menu under the button after removing any other header menu. Rows can be links, plain buttons, or groups of small option buttons, and choosing an entry closes the menu and runs its handler; an empty list shows nothing.

jobs: build a small text button for a menu option
close the menu when an option is chosen
summary: Turns one option, with a label, a tooltip, and a handler, into a small text button. Pressing it stops the click reaching the page, closes the menu, and runs the option's handler.

jobs: place a menu just under the header
keep a menu inside the window edge
summary: Positions an open menu just below the header and aligned with its anchor, and does nothing once the menu has been removed. If the menu runs past the right edge of the window, it shifts left by the overflow, but never past a small margin at the left edge.

jobs: close a menu on a click outside it
stop listening after the first outside click
summary: Waits for the next tick, then listens for a click anywhere on the page. A click outside both the menu and its button removes the menu and stops the listener.

jobs: build a round outlined icon button
run a handler when the button is pressed
summary: Takes an icon name and a click handler, and returns a small round outlined button that shows the icon, labeled with the icon name. The handler is attached as the button's click action.

jobs: show or hide the header and footer
skip the change when nothing differs
summary: Sets whether the header and footer are hidden and, only when the state actually changes, adds or removes the hidden class on every bar element. The bars are hidden by display rather than by transform, so the content around them takes up the freed space.

jobs: hide header and footer while reading down
show header and footer when scrolling up
summary: Handles a scroll inside the viewer's panel and ignores scrolling outside it or in elements with nothing to scroll vertically. Within 4 pixels of the top it shows the bars, and otherwise a downward move of 8 pixels or more hides them and an upward move shows them, while smaller moves change nothing.

jobs: toggle header and footer on a body tap
ignore taps on controls and the bars
summary: A tap on the page content, outside the header, the footer, and any control, flips the bars between shown and hidden. Taps on the bars, on controls, or on the viewer's own tap targets are left alone.

jobs: show whether the contents list is open
label the contents mark for its state
summary: Shows a caret while the table of contents is open and the viewer's usual icon otherwise. Where the viewer has a contents mark, it also sets the mark's tooltip, label, and expanded state to match.

jobs: list one row per slide in the contents
label each row from a caller function
mark the row for the current slide
add headings where sections begin
go to a slide when its row is tapped
summary: Rebuilds the list from one row per slide, labeled by a caller-supplied function where a plain string counts as a title and a label that throws counts as blank. Each row shows its number and title, an unlabeled row shows only its number, and the current slide's row is highlighted; the function returns the current slide index.

jobs: open the table of contents under its mark
scroll the current row into the middle
add a history entry for Back
listen for outside taps from the next frame
summary: Does nothing when the list is already open or the viewer has no label function. Otherwise it builds the rows, places the list under the mark as measured at that moment, centers the current row, and pushes a history entry; outside taps count only from the next frame, so the tap that opened the list does not close it.

jobs: close the table of contents
step back once in history
flag that history pop as its own
summary: Does nothing unless the list is open. Otherwise it removes the list and its outside-tap listener, refreshes the mark, and then, unless told not to, steps back once in history and flags one pending pop as its own, clearing that flag after half a second if no pop arrives.

jobs: attach a drag handle when the pane is docked
remove the drag handle when docking ends
refresh the handle's measurements
summary: When the pane is docked and the host can take a width, attaches a vertical drag splitter bounded to the whole window, then a frame later refreshes it so it reads the settled width. When docking ends or no width can be set, it destroys the splitter and removes its element; otherwise an existing splitter is refreshed.

jobs: show the current slide number
hide arrows at the first and last slides
highlight the current pager dot or bar
tell the caller the slide changed
summary: Given the current slide index, updates the number shown, hides the previous arrow on the first slide and the next arrow on the last, and either highlights the matching dot or sets the progress bar's width. It then calls the caller's slide handler if one was given.

jobs: close the slide viewer once
take the viewer off the stack
restore the page's scroll setting
release every slide and the splitter
animate out, then remove the viewer
run the release and close callbacks
summary: Runs once however often it is called: it closes the table of contents without touching history, removes its listeners and stack entry, restores the page's scroll setting, and releases the slides and any splitter. The viewer slides out first when it was nested and is then removed, and the caller's close callback runs last.

jobs: close this viewer and any opened above it
step back history past every layer
summary: Does nothing if the viewer is already closed or not on the stack. Otherwise it adds up the history entries held by this viewer and those above it, closes the viewers above and any open table of contents, and steps history back past all of them, which leads to the cleanup.

jobs: let Back close the top layer
ignore history pops it caused itself
summary: Handles a history pop for the top viewer only. A pop the viewer caused itself is consumed and ignored, Back closes an open table of contents if there is one, and otherwise Back closes the viewer.

jobs: close the top layer on Escape
step slides with the arrow keys
ignore arrow keys while the list is open
summary: Acts only for the top viewer and skips keys that were already handled. While the table of contents is open, Escape closes it and every other key is ignored; otherwise Escape closes the viewer and the left and right arrows move to the previous and next slide.

jobs: slide the viewer in from the right
clear the transition styles afterward
summary: Animates the viewer from its off-screen position to rest over about 0.22 seconds, then after 280 milliseconds clears the inline transition and transform so the page's own styles take over.

jobs: build a read-one-at-a-time label
pluralize a noun for a count
summary: Builds the label Read N items one at a time for a one-at-a-time reading control, with the noun singular for a count of one, plural otherwise, and the number formatted for the locale. A zero or missing count leaves the number out, so the label reads Read items one at a time.

jobs: build a one-at-a-time reading button
attach the open handler to the button
summary: Returns a round icon button whose tooltip and label come from the count and noun, with an icon that defaults to a shared one and a class that depends on the size. When an open handler is given, it becomes the button's click action.

jobs: register the file browser component by name
make it available to page markup
summary: Registers the file browser under a fixed name so page markup can create one. It takes no input and returns nothing, and the component's behavior is defined in the factory it registers.

jobs: show a folder tree above a file strip
keep the selected file in step
open the folder's files in a full-screen view
summary: Builds the state and methods for a browser that shows a folder tree above a horizontal strip of the files in the chosen folder, with one file selected at a time. It takes a repository, a ref, a starting folder, and optionally a file, keeps the selection, strip position, and tree highlight in step, and can open the folder's files in a full-screen view.

jobs: write the browser's markup into its root
rebuild the strip when the folder changes
keep the selection and strip in step
step files with the arrow keys
summary: Writes the markup into the component's root, then watches the folder listing and the selected file so the strip is rebuilt or repositioned to match. It also adds a window-level key listener, which the destroy method removes, that steps through files on the arrow keys.

jobs: wire up the folder picker after render
select the file given at start
summary: After the next render, and only if the root is still on the page, initializes the markup's bindings, keeps the folder picker control, and selects the starting file when one was given.

jobs: set the selection from the strip position
load slides near the current one
highlight the matching row in the tree
summary: When the position lands on a file, makes that file the selection if it differs. Then it loads the slides beside the current one, marks the matching tree row, and scrolls that row into view.

jobs: step files up and down from the tree
step files left and right over the strip
ignore keys typed into form fields
summary: Does nothing when no file is shown, the root has left the page, or the key comes from a text field or a select. Up and Down step through the files while the pointer or focus is in the tree, skipping folders, and Left and Right step while the pointer is over the strip; a step prevents the key's default action.

jobs: list the files in the shown folder
write each path from the repository root
summary: Returns the paths, from the repository root, of the files directly inside the folder the tree is showing, skipping subfolders. It returns an empty list when the tree is not at a folder inside a repository.

jobs: rebuild the strip with one slot per file
reset which slots are filled
clear the tree cursor in an empty folder
summary: Replaces the strip's contents with one empty slot per file in the folder and forgets which slots were filled. It then places the selection, and in a folder with no files it clears the tree cursor, which a later hover sets again.

jobs: build an empty full-width slot for a file
tag the slot with its position
summary: Returns an empty block sized to the full width of the strip and tagged with its position in the folder. The file path it is given is not used.

jobs: move the strip to the selected file
select the first file in a folder
summary: If the selection is one of the folder's files, moves the strip to it, instantly when asked. Otherwise it clears the position and, when the folder has files, selects the first one so a folder with files never opens empty.

jobs: move to a file in the strip
clamp the index to the folder's files
scroll the strip to that file
summary: Clamps the index into the range of files and records it as the current position at once. It then scrolls the strip so that file's slot lines up with the left edge, instantly when asked and smoothly otherwise, and does nothing for an empty folder or a slot not yet built.

jobs: find the slot nearest the strip edge
update the position from scrolling
summary: Measures each slot's distance from the strip's left edge and picks the nearest. It records that slot as the current position only when it differs from the current one, and does nothing without a strip or a current position.

jobs: load the viewers for nearby slides
load each slide only once
summary: Covers the current slot and the one on each side. Any of those not yet loaded gets a file viewer, and each is recorded so it is never loaded twice.

jobs: mark the selected file in the tree
move the tree cursor to that file
summary: Sets the picker's picked file to the current selection, or to none when there is no current position. It then moves the picker's cursor to the matching entry, if one exists.

jobs: put a file viewer into a slot
open the row the address names
summary: Creates a viewer inside the slot for one file, set to a read mode chosen from the file's type. For the file the address names, it passes the table row and column so the viewer opens there, and then calls a helper that fetches and shows the file's contents.

jobs: fetch a file's text from the repository
show the text in the slot's viewer
show a load error in the slot
summary: Fetches the file's text at the chosen ref with the page's access token, and passes it to the viewer if that viewer is still on the page. If the fetch fails, it removes the viewer and writes a short error line with the message into the slot.

jobs: open the folder's files in a full-screen view
load the slide viewer when missing
open above any slide viewer already open
show a warning if it fails
summary: Does nothing while an open is under way, when a viewer is already open, or when the folder has no files. Otherwise it loads the slide viewer if needed, opens the folder's files starting at the selected one, stacks them above any viewer already open, and moves the selection with the slide; a failure shows a warning message.

jobs: update the viewer header for the new file
select the file the viewer moved to
summary: Runs as the slide viewer moves, once it exists. It sets the header's title, subtitle, icon, and link from the file at that position, and selects that file in the browser if it is not already selected.

jobs: build the header text for a file
link the header to the file on GitHub
summary: Returns the header for the file at a slide index: the file name as the title, the repository name with any ref and folder as the subtitle, a file icon, and a link to the file on GitHub. The link is absent when that slide has no file.

jobs: register the this-browser view by name
make it available to page markup
summary: Registers the this-browser view component once the page's framework is ready, so markup can create one. It takes no input and returns nothing, and its behavior is defined in the factory it registers.

jobs: read storage without ever throwing
name the owner of each stored key
format byte counts and dates for display
set up the view's starting state
summary: Sets up the helpers the browser-storage view needs: a safe read, a table naming which part of the app writes each stored key or database, and formatters for sizes and dates. It then returns the view's starting state and the first part of its markup, the header, tabs, and start of the token pane.

jobs: show the token status and its details
take a token from the reader
list stored keys and databases to pick
summary: Continues the markup with a warning when a request failed, a back link, the token's status and details, and the token entry and links. It then lists the local storage keys and IndexedDB databases with their owners and record counts, and an import link for legacy databases.

jobs: show the selected stored item beside the list
step through items with buttons
open the stored items in a full-screen view
summary: Closes the list and adds the item viewer: a header with the current item's name, its position, previous and next buttons, and a full-screen button, above a horizontal strip with one slot per item. Scrolling the strip picks the item in view, and the list beside it follows the selection.

jobs: move the selection by key, button or swipe
scroll the strip to the selected item
load this browser's storage
ask the opening page for its storage
summary: Holds the methods for the stored-items view: choosing an item, moving through the list and strip by key, button or swipe while keeping them in step, opening the full-screen view, and loading this browser's storage or that of the page it was opened from. It ends the component definition.

jobs: name the format of a GitHub token
tell a token's format from its prefix
summary: Returns a short label for a token's format, judged by its prefix or length: fine-grained, classic, OAuth, GitHub App, older 40-character classic, or unrecognized. It does not check whether GitHub accepts the token.

jobs: show a stored value for reading
mask a token to its last four characters
pretty-print a stored JSON object
summary: Returns a display name and content for a stored value: a token shows only its last four characters, a value that parses as an object or array is pretty-printed under a JSON name, and anything else is shown as plain text. A value that cannot be read is treated as empty.

jobs: put a fresh file viewer into a container
start it in its default read mode
summary: Replaces the container's contents with a new file viewer element, starts it, and returns the element. The viewer picks its read mode from the file's type and is not bound to a shared store.

jobs: write the view's markup into its root
read the saved browser note
check the saved token with GitHub
watch the selection, tab, and page
summary: Writes the markup, reads the saved note and the just-saved marker, then checks the token. It also sets watchers so that a change of selected item moves the strip, a change of tab loads that tab's data, and a page that announces itself while its tab is open has its storage loaded.

jobs: initialize the markup's bindings
load storage for the current tab
summary: Once the view is still on the page, initializes its markup and loads the storage for the current tab: the page's values when that tab is current, otherwise this browser's.

jobs: load the storage of a newly opened tab
move the strip to the selected item
summary: When the tab changes to the page or stored tab, loads that source if it is not already loaded. For either storage tab, it then moves the strip to the selected item and keeps it in view in the list.

jobs: name a failed GitHub request in one line
pick the headline by status and quota
summary: Returns the headline for the last failed request. A 401 reads as a rejected saved token when a token was sent and as a refused request otherwise, and a 403 with no quota left reads as the hourly limit reached, with the anonymous wording when no token was sent; other failures read as refused, and an empty string means no request has failed.

jobs: split a failed request line for display
break the line only after separators
summary: Builds the method and full API address of the last failed request, dropping the host and adding the repository path when the address is relative. It splits the line after each slash, question mark, and ampersand so the display can wrap there, and returns an empty list when nothing has failed.

jobs: describe this browser and device in one line
say how the page is being run
summary: Joins the page's host, browser name, operating system, whether it runs as a home-screen app or a browser tab, and whether input is touch or mouse and keyboard, separated by dots and skipping any empty part.

jobs: describe the token's permission scopes
say when scopes are not reported
summary: Returns nothing when no token is saved or the check did not accept it. A fine-grained token is reported as not listing scopes, and any other token lists the scopes GitHub returned, or none if there were none.

jobs: show the remaining hourly request count
format counts with digit grouping
summary: Returns the remaining requests and the hourly limit as remaining over limit per hour, with thousands separators. It returns an empty string when the limit is unknown, and shows a question mark when the remaining count is missing.

jobs: turn the token check state into a status line
show the check's failure message
summary: Returns a status phrase for the current stage of the token check: checking, accepted with the account name, rejected, hourly limit reached, none saved, or failed with its message. An idle check gives an empty string.

jobs: pick an icon for the token check state
flag a token that lacks repo scope
summary: Returns the icon and color class for the token check state, with a warning icon for a token that lacks the repository scope. A state with no entry in the table gets a spinning placeholder icon.

jobs: explain the likely cause of a token problem
note whether a reader's note is kept
summary: Returns a short likely cause once the token check has finished and found a problem: no token saved, with a note on whether the reader's note is kept, a token GitHub rejected, or a token without the repository scope, which hides private repositories. It returns an empty string while checking or when nothing is wrong.

jobs: check the saved token with GitHub
record quota and scopes from the reply
record the account that accepted a token
summary: Reads the saved token and asks GitHub about it: the account when a token exists, or the anonymous limit when none does. It sets the check state to accepted, rejected, hourly limit reached, error, or none saved, and records the remaining quota and scopes from the response headers; a network failure becomes an error state carrying its message.

jobs: check a typed token's shape
save a valid token
reload the page after saving
summary: Trims the typed value and rejects an empty one or one without the shape of a GitHub token, with a message naming the expected prefixes. A valid token is saved and its last four characters are kept in session storage, then the page reloads so the new token is checked.

jobs: confirm before removing the saved token
clear the token and reload the page
summary: Asks the reader to confirm, then clears the saved token and reloads the page. Declining leaves everything as it was.

jobs: save a short browser note
remove the note when left blank
show a brief saved confirmation
summary: Trims the note draft: a blank draft removes the saved note, and anything else is saved. A storage error is shown as a message; on success it shows saved or removed for two seconds and reloads the storage list.

jobs: summarize the stored local keys
total the bytes of stored keys
summary: Returns none when there are no keys, or a count of keys with their total size, in the singular or plural as needed. When there are no rows because a read failed, it returns an empty string so the error shows instead.

jobs: summarize the stored databases
report a database list still loading
summary: Returns reading while the database list loads and a note when this browser does not list databases, and an empty string in other states. Once loaded it gives none or the number of databases.

jobs: switch the view to a tab
update the address to show the tab
summary: Does nothing when no page shell exists or the tab is already selected. Otherwise it records the new tab on the shell and refreshes the address, so the tab is part of the link.
